name: Passionfruit syrup
method: Combine ingredients in a clean pan and warm gently until sugar dissolves.
Cool promptly under the venue procedure.
Measure the finished yield; this example targets approximately 1 L. Bottle, label and chill.
storageInstructions: Clean sealed container, refrigerated and dated.
shelfLife: Example target: 3 days; venue must validate.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service. The displayed recipe is a nominal 1 L formulation; confirm yield before scaling.

name: Ginger syrup
method: Simmer ginger and water briefly to extract flavour.
Strain, dissolve the sugar in the strained liquid, then cool promptly.
Measure final yield and bottle under the venue procedure. Nominal yield: 1 L.
storageInstructions: Sealed, labelled container in the refrigerator.
shelfLife: Example target: 3 days; venue must validate.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service.

name: Citrus cordial
method: Mix measured citrus juices and water.
Stir in sugar until fully dissolved.
Fine strain, measure final yield and bottle. Nominal yield: 1 L.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate in a clean labelled bottle.
shelfLife: Example target: 2 days; venue must validate.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service.

name: Fresh lime juice

recipe.name: Limes
recipe.notes: Fruit yield varies; quantity is a purchasing estimate for 1 L.

method: Wash and prepare fruit with clean equipment.
Juice and fine strain.
Measure the actual yield, bottle and date. Nominal recipe target: 1 L.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate immediately in a clean sealed bottle; rotate small bottles during service.
shelfLife: Same service day; follow venue policy.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service.

name: Pineapple foam

recipe.name: Sugar syrup
recipe.notes: 1:1 sugar to water by weight unless the product label specifies otherwise.

method: Combine ingredients and strain finely.
Whisk or use an approved foaming method immediately before service.
Test foam texture and portion size; nominal liquid base yield is 500 ml.
storageInstructions: Keep the base refrigerated in a clean labelled container; foam small amounts at service.
shelfLife: Same service day; follow venue policy.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service. Illustrative aquafaba foam only. This is not the Rockwater foam recipe. Check supplier allergens; do not assume a shared bar is allergen-free.

name: Earl Grey gin infusion
method: Combine the gin and tea in a clean covered container.
Taste at short intervals; strain when the desired aroma is reached, before tannins become harsh.
Fine filter and record actual yield. Nominal starting batch: 700 ml.
storageInstructions: Sealed, labelled container; follow approved spirit-infusion storage procedure.
shelfLife: Example quality target: 7 days; venue must validate.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service. Pilot formula for training, not a scheduled Rockwater preparation.

name: Fresh citrus garnish set
method: Wash fruit and sanitise preparation surfaces.
Cut approximately 30 service pieces; exact yield depends on fruit size and cut.
Keep fruit types separate and record the actual count.
shelfLife: Same service day; follow venue policy.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service.

name: Dried pineapple fans
method: Slice pineapple evenly into approximately 20 garnish pieces.
Use the venue’s approved dehydrator settings and validated drying process.
Cool fully before packing and check that no moisture is trapped.
storageInstructions: Airtight dry container only after validated drying; label with prep date.
shelfLife: Set by validated drying and storage procedure.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service. No fixed shelf life is claimed because thickness, drying and storage determine stability.

name: Negroni spirit batch
method: Measure all ingredients into a clean batching container.
Mix, bottle and label as 10 serves of 90 ml before service dilution.
At service, measure 90 ml over ice, stir and garnish. Nominal batch yield: 900 ml.
storageInstructions: Refrigerate the sealed batch because it contains opened vermouth.
shelfLife: Example quality target: 7 days; venue must validate.
notes: SAMPLE recipe and planning quantities. Validate the recipe, final yield, allergens and holding policy before service. Contains sulphites from vermouth; verify product labels. No service dilution is included in this batch.
